card: Adds detailed debug and trace logging for compact block reconstruction and GETBLOCKTXN responses, recording counts and byte sizes for transactions obtained from prefills, the mempool, the extrapool, and peer requests. It tracks redundant prefilled transactions against local pools, decouples extrapool counting from mempool counting, and logs complete lists of missing transaction IDs at trace level instead of suppressing outputs with five or more missing transactions. This provides better observability into compact block reconstruction performance and was split out to assist evaluation of prefilling compact blocks in PR 35558.
evidence: PR description: "Split from #35558, this makes it easier to observe compact block reconstruction performance by: - At debuglevel=trace logging all missing TX's in a CMPCTBLOCK, and all missing TX's requested from us. - Logging the sizes and counts of tx's used from the prefill, mempool, and extrapool. - Logging the sizes and sources of redundant transactions in the prefill section of received `CMPCTBLOCK`s."

Commit 4d3acd52af: "It doesn't make that much sense to log here only when there's a few transactions, since either a user is interested in what tx'es caused reconstruction to fail or they aren't, so log all txid's and this a trace-level log message."
problem: Evaluating compact block reconstruction efficiency is difficult because existing logs do not report transaction byte sizes or prefill redundancy, and extrapool hits are conflated with mempool matches. Furthermore, missing transaction IDs are only logged when fewer than five are missing, preventing operators from diagnosing larger reconstruction roundtrips.

risk.why: A logic error in PartiallyDownloadedBlock transaction accounting or loop-termination conditions could cause unnecessary GETBLOCKTXN roundtrips or block reconstruction delays.

summary: Expands compact block (CMPCTBLOCK) logging during block reconstruction and when serving GETBLOCKTXN requests. At debug level BCLog::CMPCTBLOCK, it records counts and byte sizes of transactions obtained from prefills, the mempool, the extrapool, and peer requests, and tracks redundant prefilled transactions. At trace level, it logs all missing transaction IDs rather than suppressing lists when five or more transactions are missing. It also decouples extrapool counting from mempool counts in PartiallyDownloadedBlock.
